{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Red long-sleeve knit top, relaxed fit with a crew neckline, hip length, red #C1272D, soft cotton-blend knit

High-waisted straight-leg jeans, full length to the ankle, dark indigo #1F2A44, stretch denim

Slim belt, thin leather strap with a small gold buckle, dark brown #3B2417, smooth leather

Ankle boots, low block heel, round toe, tobacco brown #6B4423, suede

Crossbody bag, small structured shape, cognac #8B4A2B, grained leather

Gold hoop earrings, medium size, warm gold #C9A24A, polished metal

Light wool-blend scarf, loosely draped, length to mid-torso, warm camel #B88A5A, soft wool

Light trench coat, straight cut, knee length, sand beige #C8B08A, cotton gabardine

This outfit works because the red knit is the clear focus you asked for, and its warm, rich tone sits beautifully against deeply colored skin. Dark indigo jeans and tobacco-brown boots ground the look in neat everyday style that suits an autumn meet-up with friends. The camel scarf, cognac bag and gold hoops repeat warm tones, so the whole outfit feels cohesive and relaxed. The straight cut of the jeans and the hip-length top keep the silhouette balanced and comfortable for sitting in a café or walking around, while the light trench covers you from the chill of the season."}
